precision_schedule.fixed_C: 80-digit full Cholesky inverse transpose rounded once to binary64; identical C across each arm's transform comparisons
precision_schedule.transform_internal_comparison: 64 vs 113 raw MO and H differences preserved; energy empirical convergence <=1e-12 Eh, independent of reference
precision_schedule.ground_refinement: 113-bit full-H Rayleigh/residual correction, binary64 full-spectrum eigenbasis as preconditioner only; max 4 corrections; internal absolute energy change and residual <=1e-24; no spatial projection

canonical_rule: Only AO lower-one-body and descending eightfold ERI representatives, chosen from fresh raw ordered AO. No MO representative reuse and no Hamiltonian copying/averaging. Raw permutations measured before AO reuse
53bit_compact_direct: Same canonical full AO and identical saved C, PySCF compact incore versus independent four einsum contractions; no energy from a pre-eigensolve guard failure
64_113bit_direct: Independent native explicit four-index ordered contractions; identical AO dyadics and C dyadics; independently computed permutations retained, no MO reuse
CI: Full upper-lex i<=j spatial singlet, all 1830 rows and columns. Native explicit ordered four-term spatial assembly; independent fermion Slater-Condon selected rows and ground-state action validate assembly
lowest_root: Hint-free full-spectrum numpy syevd plus independent scipy evr first two roots, complete dimension/order and positive next-root gap recorded. High-precision residual refinement remains attached to full-spectrum lowest root; this is numerical evidence, not a formal lowest-root certificate
post_eigensolve_guards: mandatory spatial and spin symmetry residuals
failed_pre_guard: STOP arm before any eigensolver; no energy calculated, inferred or filled
failed_post_guard: Preserve actually computed diagnostic result, never overall accepted; do not compute a replacement energy
common_representation: Both arms use the same verified AO polynomial definitions. Cross-arm AO comparisons remain in that unaltered AO representation. Cross-arm MO comparisons, if made, use explicitly verified U=C_L^{-1}C_I with C_L U=C_I; preserve S differences and metric mismatch separately
higher_accuracy_AO_scope: Independent Hermite Gaussian spot integrals only, with exact promotion of sealed exponent/radial/polynomial dyadics. Full higher-precision AO engine and full-AO energy error bound unavailable in deployed libcint/Libint2 binary64 engines; no claim of full AO accuracy
